_help: The skill window box in 1366x768 space. x/y = the window top-left (the file wins until the player drags the window). w/h = the window size (the official art is 318x361). The other spots are window-local inside the official art: panelX/panelY = the light body panel, barX/barY = the blue bar (the picked skill), spX/spY = the SKILL POINT art, spValX/spValY = the SP number (spValX is its right edge), jobX/jobY = the job name. tabX/tabY/tabStep = the job tab row (three Roman numeral tabs), tabArtY = how much lower the unselected tab art sits. listX/listY = the first skill row, rowPitch = the step between the rows and the row height: the official row art is 140x35, but 8 skills must fit under the blue bar, so the step is 32 and the art is cut to it. rowIconX/rowIconY = the skill icon, rowNameX/rowNameY = the name, rowSubX/rowSubY = the sub line, rowRightX = the right edge of the sub line. pickIconX/pickIconY, pickNameX/pickNameY, pickRightX = the blue bar text. detailX/detailY/detailW/detailH = the skill info box (the official skill tooltip frame), textX/textY = the first line inside it, detailLine = the line step. plusX/plusY = the [+] button, maxX/maxY = the MAX button, maxW/maxH = the MAX box. titleH = the title strip. closeX = the gap from the right edge to the X button, closeY = its top. Keys may be omitted (keeps the default).
